create.name: Susa Talan
create.bio:
Susa Talan is an insight meditation teacher, artist and writer in Portland, Maine. She was drawn to meditation by noticing how persuasive, and how unreliable, the stories in her own head could be, and that question led her to the Burmese teacher Sayadaw U Tejaniya, under whom she ordained for a short period in 2010 and with whom she has practised for close to twenty years. She has also received teachings from Yongey Mingyur Rinpoche in the Tibetan tradition, spent four years as a senior producer of meditation content for Dan Harris's meditation app, and in 2017 helped Alexis Santos and others found the Open Door Meditation Community in Portland.

Following her teacher, she presents meditation less as a matter of posture than as looking after the mind through the whole day, with relaxed, steady awareness allowing understanding to grow by itself. She draws openly on her own life with ADHD when helping restless meditators find a way in. She offers one-to-one meditation mentoring on a sliding scale, a Thursday evening online sitting group, and a monthly online daylong co-led with Alexis Santos, as well as gentle movement classes drawing on qigong and yoga. Most of her teaching is given on a donation basis.

courses.title: Meditation mentoring
courses.description: One-to-one online sessions for people starting a practice or wanting to deepen one, covering formal sitting and how to stay aware in everyday life. Sessions are 30 minutes and booked through her website.

courses.title: Thursday evening meditation
courses.description: An online evening group in which she guides a sitting, gives a short dharma reflection and then opens the floor for questions and practice discussion. Newcomers are welcome to come and simply listen.

courses.title: Monthly online daylong retreat with Alexis Santos
courses.description: A day of online practice held once a month with her fellow teacher Alexis Santos, currently working through Sayadaw U Tejaniya's book Relax and Be Aware. People can join for part of the day or all of it.

free_resources.title: About meditation
free_resources.description: A free page on her site introducing the approach she learned from Sayadaw U Tejaniya, with basic principles for caring for the mind and a reading list of his books and other dharma resources.
